scientific_limitations: Only unital F_q-linear subalgebras of the free commutative cube-zero local algebra are counted.
The concentration limit is for fixed q as the embedding dimension tends to infinity.
The 1975 Strade paper on enumeration in nilpotent algebras could not be inspected in full; publication priority remains provisional.
Exhaustive computation was confined to the smallest prime-field cases.
title: Unital subalgebra rank polynomial and cotangent-line concentration in free cube-zero local rings
